summary: Intent-indexed first-tool routing vocabulary for repo-aware agents. This data guides workspace_tool_router_recommend and discovery metadata; it does not dispatch, mutate, lint, or replace the authority of the recommended tools.

authority.misuse_code_policy: Do not define WK-1437 misuse codes in this file. Replacement guidance names tools and bounded reasons only until the WK-1437 tool-use-policy.v1 vocabulary is available.

matched.description: Exactly one routing intent is selected after deterministic overlap handling.
matched.server_state_contract: A missing request field that the route declares in server_state_fields is reported in server_state_fields with the result field of its declared read instead of in required_authored_fields. When that read is visible and its arguments satisfy its registered request contract, next_calls contains that read as the one recommended call; the incomplete operation itself is never emitted.

ambiguous.description: Two or more intents remain plausible after deterministic overlap handling and available prerequisite state is insufficient to choose.

bounded_guidance.ask_for: the smallest missing identifier, state marker, or user choice needed to distinguish the candidate intents
bounded_guidance.omission_contract: When candidate_set_complete is false, candidate_count_total is exact and complete_candidate_set_next_call is an unflagged canonical workspace_tool_router_recommend call with candidate_view=complete. The continuation returns every task-selected candidate without recommending one.
bounded_guidance.choice_contract: Each ranked clarification choice names the exact operation, its known arguments, and required_authored_fields. A choice whose arguments satisfy the operation's registered request contract also appears in next_calls as an unflagged executable alternative; an incomplete choice is guidance only. No ambiguous next_calls entry is recommended.

visibility_withheld.description: A semantic intent matched but its operation is absent from the launcher/server-minted role-visible descriptor.

unknown.description: No routing intent matches the task after normalization and phrase matching.
unknown.deterministic_no_match_behavior: Return unknown without guessing, reading records, dispatching, mutating, linting, or selecting a broad/full tool as a fallback.
unknown.stop_recovery_contract: Return exactly one operative limb: a bounded canonical recommended next_calls recovery when an exact discovery selector or docs path is already known, otherwise next_calls is empty and stop_condition, no_supported_route, and recovery.state all explicitly state no_supported_route.

guidance: Use workspace_tools_list filtered by a known task_id, or workspace_tools_describe for a known tool_name, only for bounded tool discovery when the task is still a repo-tool question.
Use workspace_search_repo only when the user is asking for docs/wiki lookup or canonical page discovery.
Ask the user for the missing durable identifier or scope when the task cannot be classified from the provided text.

normalization: treat hyphen, underscore, slash, and whitespace as token separators
preserve durable identifiers such as IN-*, WK-*, WK-*#SLICE-*, DEC-*, SRC-*, and docs paths as prerequisite state

overlap_rules.reason: acceptance-coverage mappings use the bounded describe/create/upsert/remove/query/rebase family and do not assess proof adequacy

overlap_rules.when: task asks to author or edit a controlled-contract carrier
overlap_rules.reason: controlled-contract carriers use their bounded package-backed authoring routes, not generic work-record setters

overlap_rules.when: task asks for controlled-contract proof selection
overlap_rules.reason: controlled-contract proof selection uses package-backed proof routes

overlap_rules.when: task asks for a controlled proof plan
overlap_rules.reason: controlled proof plans use their bounded carrier route

overlap_rules.when: task asks to assess integration-test design adequacy or sufficiency

controlled-contract assessment uses its package-backed assessment route

overlap_rules.when: task asks to launch, start, assign, run, or dispatch a worker, reviewer, or redteam role
overlap_rules.reason: a concrete start or role call goes to the descriptor-owned dispatch operation; readiness assessment is optional and is not a prerequisite call

overlap_rules.when: task asks whether a unit is dispatchable or ready without asking to launch a role
overlap_rules.reason: dispatch readiness is a structured decision, not manual record inspection

overlap_rules.when: task asks to assign or reassign a record-level WK to an initiative, including recovery from a missing_initiative_ref_namespace dispatch refusal
overlap_rules.reason: WK.initiative has one owning operation; the general editor and slice shaping do not write it

overlap_rules.when: task names a specific supported work-record mutation
overlap_rules.reason: a named mutation starts at its validated owning operation rather than a record read

overlap_rules.when: task includes a selected slice address such as WK-0001#SLICE-002 or asks for one slice's detail
overlap_rules.reason: selected-slice reads avoid full tracker payloads

overlap_rules.when: task asks for the initiative or unit status lens rather than the status of a dispatched run
overlap_rules.reason: the status lens aggregates initiative and unit state; it is not an agent-run status

overlap_rules.when: task asks to monitor a run and names a slice address as that run's subject
overlap_rules.reason: a slice address in a monitoring request is the run subject, not a request for the slice record

overlap_rules.when: task asks what should happen next, next action, frontier action, blocker to clear, or prepare dispatch across an initiative
overlap_rules.reason: next-action questions need the action lens, not only status counts

overlap_rules.when: task asks for status, where things stand, open counts, or current frontier without action language
overlap_rules.reason: initiative state is aggregated by the status lens, not docs search
